object.attr: stakeholder: an object ID names one object for good, because links on other branches, history, Compare and issued PDFs refer to it. Fixing ID reuse was decided on 2026-11-06 (open question Q7). Taking the higher of the two also covers a manifest written by a Mellon that doesn't record the number.
object.description: When Mellon creates an object, Mellon shall give the new object the higher of the document's next object number and one more than the highest object number in the document.
